fusions.name: Rolling Clamp
fusions.desc: Clamps onto an enemy at or below 30% health and rolls it for 26 damage, consuming every affliction on it and adding 1.6 times their remaining damage. The roll stuns it for 0.8 seconds.

fusions.name: From the Shallows
fusions.desc: Lunges up to 5 tiles onto an enemy for 13 damage, rising to 1.3 times that from full range. Its damage rises 10% for every 10% of health the target still has (max +40%).

fusions.name: Still Water Stalk
fusions.desc: You are veiled for 10 seconds: enemies notice you 70% later. Attacking ends it.

fusions.name: Lurker's Meal
fusions.desc: Your critical chance rises by 30% against enemies that have not yet been hurt. When you kill an enemy, you regain 3 health a second for 5 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
